description: Create a translation draft. Stage a new translation draft against a target profile, optionally seeding its keys from a source profile.

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `i18n_drafts_list` call. It proves you listed existing i18n drafts and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `i18n_drafts_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name.description: Draft name, e.g. the target locale being staged.

source_profile_id.description: Optional profile to seed the draft's keys from.

name: i18n_drafts_create
